# Check East Point

> Crowd levels for travellers in Korea: live crowd levels for 130+ places in Seoul (updated every 5 minutes) and 30-day crowd forecasts for 38 places in Jeju and 37 in Busan, in Korean, English, Japanese and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).

Check East Point helps visitors pick quieter times and places. Each place page shows a 0-100 crowd score, the busiest and quietest times, a recommended visit time, quieter alternatives nearby, map directions (Naver, Kakao, Google) and an FAQ.

- Seoul (live): Seoul Metropolitan Government real-time population data for the 121 official places (KOGL Type 1, attribution required), refreshed every 5 minutes. A few spots outside the official list are labelled as estimates.
- Jeju and Busan (forecast): Korea Tourism Organization visitor concentration forecast (based on KT mobile data), a relative 30-day scale where 100 = the busiest period, refreshed daily with a base date.
- Score bands: 0-39 relaxed, 40-69 moderate, 70-84 crowded, 85-100 very crowded.

## Main pages

- [Seoul live crowd map](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en): map and ranked list of all Seoul places
- [All Seoul places](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/list)
- [Jeju crowd forecast](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/jeju)
- [Busan crowd forecast](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/busan)
- [Seoul palaces](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/seoul/palaces), [Seoul night views](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/seoul/night-view), [Busan beaches](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/busan/beaches), [Jeju beaches](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/jeju/beaches)
- [How crowd levels work](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/about/methodology)
- [About](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/about)

## Place pages

One page per place and language: https://www.checkeastpoint.com/{lang}/spot/{slug} (lang: none for Korean, en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw), e.g. [Gyeongbokgung](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/spot/gyeongbokgung-palace-gwanghwamun), [Haeundae Beach](https://www.checkeastpoint.com/en/spot/haeundae-beach).

## Data

- Live JSON (Seoul): https://www.checkeastpoint.com/api/crowd
- Forecast JSON (Jeju/Busan): https://www.checkeastpoint.com/api/forecast
- Sitemap: https://www.checkeastpoint.com/sitemap.xml
